starting_difficulty.title: Starting Difficulty
starting_difficulty.description: Difficulty for the very first map, only when an imported character has not supplied a map.

server_password.title: Join Password
server_password.description: Written to NWX/Config/ServerSettings.ini as Password. Leave empty for an open server.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Written to NWX/Config/ServerSettings.ini as AdminPassword for Nightingale's in-game admin authentication.

max_players.title: Max Players
max_players.description: Passed as -ini:Game:[/Script/Engine.GameSession]:MaxPlayers. Nightingale documents six players as the supported maximum.

enable_cheats.title: Enable Cheats
enable_cheats.description: Cheat commands require EnableCheats on both server and client, plus in-game administrator authentication.

status_endpoint_enabled.title: Status Endpoint
status_endpoint_enabled.description: Enables the official HTTP /status endpoint on the managed status port and binds it to the selected instance address.

json_logging.title: Structured JSON Logging
json_logging.description: Enables Nightingale's documented JsonLogger output on managed stdout.

extra_launch_args.title: Extra Launch Arguments
extra_launch_args.description: Optional raw launch arguments appended to NWXServer.exe for version-specific flags not already represented by typed controls.
